provenance.content: authored for p9; no PoE names, text or verbatim values

notes.ticks: cooldowns are whole ticks, matching kit-ability and p9 combat
notes.percent: fraction stats (0.05 == 5%) so p9's (1 + value) formulas hold
notes.rage: designed secondary resource for knight; p9 currently tracks mana only
notes.flags: flag effects are game-side counters; stat effects map to StatBlock

skills.mechanic: cone melee, scales with attack speed
short dash, hits enemies on the path

kitView.note: AbilityDefinition = kitView.abilities[i]. Passive stats feed StatBlock.add; flags are read by the game, not by kit-stats. TargetSpec kinds are none/point/direction/nearest.
